sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('178a0356-4f6c-47fb-9913-f325a3c72f7b', 'cf3cfa6b-211c-452b-b18b-e462b21e6909') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
